The '''Imperial extermination ship''' was a type of [[Prison ship/Legends|dungeon ship]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Gulmalid_extermination.jpg|thumb|left|130px|The extermination process, as described by a [[Gulmarid]] survivor.]]

The class was designed with two massive blocks and a connecting superstructure situated between them. A command center was located on a forward-facing spire, while four great engines flanked each of the blocks.

The ship's lower thrusters pointed downwards and were used during atmospheric operations. The class was capable of planetary landing.
The fusion reactors that powered the ship were used to dispose of the corpses of the peoples massacred inside each vessel.

Captives were held in large pens, with guard posts overhead. From there, people were either led to experimentation chambers for gruesome tests or to ionization chambers that broke them down into their constituent parts. The survivors worked as slaves, carrying the dead into the fusion reactors.

The extermination ships had a weak spot near the connecting area of the engines to the rest of the ship. A hit from an [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] could penetrate there and overload the engines, forcing the ship to land.

==History==
The xenophobic [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Danetta Pitta]] used three such vessels, the ''[[Angrix]]'', the ''[[Apocahk]]'' and the ''[[Azgoghk]]'' to exterminate species throughout the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], during the Galactic Empire's rule over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] penetrated the still-active ''Azgoghk'' years after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] and freed the prisoners, killing both [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mir Tork]] and the sadistic [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] [[Leonis Murthé]] on contract for a surviving [[Gulmarid]], [[Slique Brighteyes]].
